hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Montclair, New Jersey as headquarters.

public_docs.notes: The public site links to a Knowledge Center, but it contains editorial resources rather than a product documentation/help center or developer portal with instructional product articles.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing is the September 2022 Series D, outside the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

founded_year.notes: Company profile gives founded year as 2013.

last_funding.notes: The announced $96M comprises $66M Series D equity and $30M revolving credit facility.

launched_6mo.notes: Sitetracker announced Scout on 2026-04-08, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage and observed navigation promote requesting a demo; no public pricing page is linked.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East).

model_provider.notes: Publicly available product, AI, security, blog, and subprocessor information reviewed did not identify a model provider.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear among customer stories on the company's customer-story page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active job board lists AI Developer - Salesforce Admin and Salesforce Administrator II - Agentic AI.

compliance_certs.notes: The company expressly describes itself as certified to SOC 1/2 and ISO 27001/27701; listed only the requested certification names.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named on the company integrations page as a supported system.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes a platform to plan, build, operate, and maintain critical infrastructure.
product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker provides an asset-lifecycle management platform for owners, operators, and contractors managing critical infrastructure projects, sites, and assets.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated C-level or VP join/departure could be verified from the sources reviewed; no sufficiently comprehensive current team record was available to support a negative.
